mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_activity (title, cover_url, content, location, registration_start_time, registration_end_time, activity_start_time, activity_end_time, max_participants, current_participants, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{coverUrl}, #{content}, #{location}, #{registrationStartTime}, #{registrationEndTime}, #{activityStartTime}, #{activityEndTime}, #{maxParticipants}, #{currentParticipants}, #{status})
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM community_activity WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT
FROM community_activity WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT
FROM community_activity WHERE deleted = 0 AND status != 'DRAFT' ORDER BY activity_start_time IS NULL, activity_start_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE community_activity
title = #{title}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, content = #{content}, location = #{location}, registration_start_time = #{registrationStartTime}, registration_end_time = #{registrationEndTime}, activity_start_time = #{activityStartTime}, activity_end_time = #{activityEndTime}, max_participants = #{maxParticipants}, status = #{status},
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE community_activity SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE community_activity SET current_participants = current_participants + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND (max_participants IS NULL OR current_participants < max_participants)
